newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Ford recalls thousands of Fiesta cars in Belgium.
newsitem.headline: Ford recalls thousands of Fiesta cars in Belgium.

text.p: Ford Motor Company (Belgium) NV, the Belgian car importing and distributing unit of U.S. Ford Inc, said it was recalling thousands of Fiesta cars to adjust the hydraulic system of clutch and brakes.
In a statement the company said the measure only applied to a number of cars of the new Fiesta and Courier models, assembled between June 1995 and July 1996.
"In Belgium it involves 8,000 cars, but some of them are still in stock," a spokesman said. "It's a preventive measure, there has been no problem," he added.
Ford Belgium said some owners had noticed the brake pedal had to be pushed in further than expected to activate the brakes.
